g.text: VAST Data funding rounds and valuations, 2019-2026
Sources: VAST Data press releases; StorageNewsletter 2021-05-05; Blocks & Files 2023-12-06 and 2026-02-05; Crunchbase News 2020-04; Bloomberg and CNBC 2026-04. Series A and early investor attribution
omitted (unconfirmed). Series F amount (~US$1B) includes a secondary tender, so it is not all new capital. Data: data/ch42_funding.csv
